reuse.why: All providers share the new link guard and reuse bank lookup and sync helpers, but Fintegra copies existing linking and download workflows.

duplication.why: The change duplicates the provider linking workflow, transaction download workflow, and local account unlink field reset.

placement.why: Provider integration follows existing module boundaries, but destructive unlink operations are concealed inside an assertion helper.

scope.why: The edits are focused on the four requested changes and their necessary provider registrations and release notes.

maintainability.why: Centralized link rules help maintenance, but copied workflows and an assertion that mutates other accounts make future changes harder to reason about.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Existing bank lookup and sync abstractions are used; unlinkAccount includes provider removal, so it is not directly suitable for local-only takeover.

disguised_duplication.where: The Fintegra linking and download workflows and local unlink reset are straightforward copies rather than disguised implementations.

abstraction_drift.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked gains replaceExistingLink and evolves from duplicate validation into mutation; added branches cover upgradingId and closed-target checks, replacement refusal, and upgradingId and missing-target checks before unlinking.
